Name: To-Dew (Real Time)
Author: CYY2023
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]An in-game to-do list mod for Stardew Valley.  All credits to original creator. [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]I changed it so the to-do list now save real-time, instead of by the end of each day.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]I do a lot of Stardew challenges so this feature is very friendly for repeatedly optimize daily routes.[/color]

If you have any questions on installation/bugs, pleas refer to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7409]original mod[/url]. It has very helpful instructions.


游戏内待办事项列表，实时保存，方便重开调整路线。
安装和其他问题请查看[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7409]原MOD[/url]的说明
其他修改相关疑问请联系[url=https://space.bilibili.com/349111916]脆音音[/url]
